n8n alternatives

n8n: Visual workflow automation with AI agents, self-host it for free or use their cloud. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI agents and automation tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1ZapierConnects thousands of apps, now with AI steps and agents in the middle.Free plan
  2. 2MakeDrag-and-drop automations across your apps, with AI wherever you need it.Free plan
  3. 3ManusA general agent that researches, builds and delivers whole tasks on its own computer.Free plan
  4. 4LindyAI assistants for email, meetings and the admin around them, set up in plain English.Free plan
  5. 5GumloopNo-code AI workflows and agents that plug into the tools a team already uses.Free plan
  6. 6Browser UseOpen-source library that lets AI agents use websites like a person would.Open source
  7. 7DifyOpen-source platform for building AI apps, RAG and agent workflows visually.Open source
  8. 8FlowiseDrag-and-drop builder for LLM agents and chatbots, open source.Open source
  9. 9CrewAIA Python framework for teams of agents that each take a role and work together.Open source
  10. 10GensparkA 'super agent' that researches, calls, books and builds documents for you.Free plan
  11. 11Relevance AIBuild a team of AI agents for sales, support and research, without code.Free plan
  12. 12BardeenAutomates browser busywork, scraping, CRM updates, outreach.Free plan
  13. 13CometPerplexity's browser, with an assistant that can do things on pages for you.Free
  14. 14ChatGPT AtlasOpenAI's browser with ChatGPT built in, and an agent mode that browses for you.Free

Free to start: Zapier, Make, Manus.
